description: This file provides utility functions for splitting strings into linked list tokens, including internal validation methods.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: Object containing static utility functions for string splitting.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a given string by spaces into a linked list, ignoring empty tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is non-empty.
